source: Design Paper (8).md, 0.7.2; parent accounting correction F=delta(P+U) outside statutory resets
independence: Designed without inspecting operating implementation or its acceptance tests. Adapter may translate inputs only after frozen SHA; no expected-outcome changes. Unsupported surfaces are BLOCKED, not PASS.

cases.category: settled residual recovery and income segregation
events: A collateral valued 4 but not sold
A collateral gross proceeds 3.75 less expenses .5 settle as 3.25 public money
quarter allowance computed with unchanged path
assert: Collateral possession alone changes neither R nor exposure
Other loan balances untouched
Loss recovery recorded once, not as interest or an issuance exception

cases.category: recovery waterfall and persistent loan identity
events: repeat reporting of same settlement ID
assert: Persistent settlement replay cannot create a second loss recovery or negative loan P/U
Accounting permits P/U residual allocation order only if total principal before interest is obeyed

cases.category: impairment resolution and cap expiry interaction
events: finally discharge 4 of P into U
advance eight quarters without Congressional action
assert: No automatic residual, clock, freeze or proof reset
Weekly overhang and eight-quarter report/vote requirement remain
Maturity alone does not retire principal

cases.category: atomic rejected statutory reset
events: at quarter boundary authorized proposed path=309 and U=2
assert: Failure because proposed overshoot 9 exceeds exposure 6
No partial path/U/allowance/epoch mutation

cases.category: rebase effective date ordering
events: enact authorized path=318 U=0 reset midquarter for next quarter boundary
close old quarter at R=320 after settled draw 2
apply authorized reset to effective-date R=320 and U=0
start epoch then compute zero-growth allowance
assert: Enactment and effective dates distinct and recorded
No interim headroom or issuance from mere enactment
Starting bound checked on closed-quarter figures

cases.category: draw-time denominator and restored room labelling
events: rule issuance increases current R to 550 within quarter
assert: Current-quarter R growth cannot alter prior-quarter denominator
Next-quarter headroom is room restored, not recovery
U never falls because R grew

cases.category: uniform clearing ties and actual settlement
events: a settles 3, b settles only 2, c settles 5.4
assert: All winners have same stated rate and face-value principal
Unsettled award does not increase B
Publish upcoming maturities and duration of remaining unfilled quantity

cases.category: short-auction streak reset and direct-sale authorization
events: auction A offers 8 settles 0 no qualifying bids
assert: Full settled auction breaks consecutive-short sequence
Direct sales never exceed remaining authorized quantity
No invented clearing price when nothing cleared

cases.category: missing readings and demand-dependent maturity replacement
events: next reading missing with matured bills principal 7
assert: Gap between available readings neither resets nor manufactures an observation
No automatic rollover or guaranteed floor
Series and vintages and missing reading published

cases.category: strict trigger threshold and active release boundary
events: available gap .01 with brake bills outstanding
assert: Exactly .03 is not greater than trigger
Missing observation does not become synthetic high reading
Floor offers distinguished from new brake sales at release threshold

cases.category: first target, stale net target and late GDP prospective use
events: missing price gap at first computation
later verified net annual target .012 and identified vintages
next computation lacks price reading and receives late GDP growth update
assert: Carry forward verified net target rather than recomputing target with new GDP and fabricated price gap
Late GDP never rewrites closed issuance
Later computation uses permitted series vintage rules

cases.category: rolling Treasury trigger across quarter boundary
events: 61 business-day closes, breached indices 1,6,11,16,21,26,31,36,41,46,60; all others compliant; quarter boundary between indices 35 and 36
assert: Compliant day and quarter boundary do not clear rolling record
Day1 drops on day61, but day61 enters
Further violation cannot restart an open remedy

cases.category: sixth close, holiday clock and credited settlement
events: sixth consecutive breached business close is Nov23
assert: Thanksgiving Nov26 and weekend excluded; violation is day0
Actual credit at Dec1 close is on time; Dec2 credit would be late
History retained after cure

cases.category: live excess recalculation and repeated open breaches
events: facility interest .5 and conversion repayment 9.5 settle reducing R to240 before day4 payout
assert: Day1 partial cure and continuing breaches do not restart deadline
Payment amount determined from actual R/T at settlement
No reserve label or queued instruction counts as cure

cases.category: daily final close rather than intraday excursion
events: tax credit raises intraday T to45
same-day settled spending reduces T to30
assert: Equality 3% is compliant
Counter is based on final settlement daily close, not intraday maximum

cases.category: quarter-end fallback with partial actual disbursement
events: following quarter actual redeemable debt redemption 3
queue dividend 4 but do not credit
segregate 7 remaining T under internal label
reach following quarter's final business close
assert: Quarter-end obligation remains independent of 3% threshold
Only actual spending/redemption reduces undisbursed amount

cases.category: emergency restart and rollover identity
events: roll EL7 to new identifier with predecessor link Apr1
assert: Low exposure alone insufficient while emergency-identified lineage remains outstanding
Fresh label or rollover cannot reset 365-day clock

cases.category: complete calendar quarter restart qualification
events: all Q2 days no emergency-identified loans, but exposure 20.01 on one day at prior_R1000
assert: Partial quarter clean period not complete calendar quarter
One-day excess, even if cured, invalidates clean quarter
U included every day

cases.category: overdue register and hard stop disclosure
events: episode recertified next day without new act
weekly register emitted seven days after maturity
assert: Overdue publication supplements rather than replaces daily usage and 24-hour action disclosure
No unnecessary private borrower data in public register
Going beyond 365 identified as hard-stop policy change only with new act

cases.category: bill face value, fiscal interest, and allowance independence
events: replacement offered7 settles3 at stated rate .05
assert: Principal maturity and fiscal interest booked separately
No discount issuance; settled3 moves exactly3 to B
Maturity, interest and replacement do not change R or create issuance room
